01 — THE BOTTLENECK

Wealth intelligence operations are still run on PDFs.

Every firm we talk to is bottlenecked by the same five problems. None are solved by another dashboard.

01 / ANALYST DRAG

Manual portfolio analysis

Analysts spend 60–80% of their time parsing CAS statements, reconciling holdings, and recomputing allocations by hand.

02 / FRAGMENTATION

Fragmented client data

Holdings sit across PDFs, broker portals, AMC feeds, and spreadsheets — never in one structured graph.

03 / GROWTH CEILING

Non-scalable advisory

A senior analyst can meaningfully service 30–50 portfolios. Firms with 500+ clients break operationally.

04 / LATENCY

Delayed client insight

Recommendations that should take minutes take days. High-value clients churn quietly while waiting.

05 / KEY-PERSON RISK

Operational dependency

The firm's intelligence lives in one analyst's head. When they leave, institutional memory leaves with them.

02 — THE PLATFORM

One intelligence layer. Every wealth workflow.

WealthOS is not a product — it's the operational substrate between fragmented client data and the advisor's recommendation. Seven deterministic layers, one source of financial truth.

CLIENT MEMO · MEHTA FAMILY OFFICE · 21 MAY 2026 · METHODOLOGY v1.2

Dear Mr. Mehta,

Your portfolio carries a moderate-to-high risk profile with a composite risk score of 68/100, driven primarily by sector concentration and factor clustering.

Your most significant risk is a 31.4% effective BFSI exposure, computed across direct holdings and through look-through analysis of 12 mutual funds. A 15% correction in private banking would translate to an estimated drawdown of −7.9% over 60 days.

The factor DNA reveals strong growth-quality bias (0.81 / 0.76) with very limited defensive positioning (0.18). We identified a diversification illusion: Axis Bluechip and Mirae LargeCap share 42.1% overlap, adding redundant HDFC Bank exposure without genuine diversification benefit.

Three recommended actions: (1) Reduce Axis fund concentration — currently 3 Axis funds. (2) Maintain debt floor 12–15% (currently 18.1%, watch for drift). (3) Trim Axis Bluechip / Mirae overlap, redeploy ₹4.2 Cr to mid-cap value.

04 — THE PIPELINE

From statement to insight in six steps.

Every step is deterministic, auditable, and reproducible. The same input always produces the same output.

01

Upload

~2s · drop or API

CAS PDFs from CAMS or KFin, broker statements, AMC feeds, or direct API ingestion. Format-agnostic. Handles locked, scanned, and consolidated statements.

PDFCSVAPIExcel
02

Extract

throughput: 10k holdings/s

Layout-aware extraction pulls holdings, transactions, costs, and metadata from any format. OCR fallback for scanned or image-only PDFs.

OCRparsersvalidators
03

Normalize

canonical instrument graph

Schemes map to canonical IDs. ISINs resolved against AMFI + NSE. Aliases reconciled. Duplicate holdings detected. Portfolio reconstructed with full audit trail.

ISINAMFIalias dict
04

Analyze

deterministic · 100% reproducible

Allocation, concentration (HHI), effective diversification (Neff), volatility, drawdown, factor exposure, look-through, overlap — all computed by code, never by LLM.

HHINefflook-throughfactors
05

Intelligence

narrative only · never math

The LLM layer reads structured JSON outputs and generates portfolio diagnostics, risk narratives, and advisor commentary. Every claim cites the deterministic source.

LLMtraceabilityHITL
06

Deliver

advisor-approved output

Client-ready review memos, advisor dashboards, embeddable insights, and audit-grade reports — gated through advisor approval before reaching the client.

PDFAPIembedaudit log
05 — CAPABILITIES

Built for institutional intelligence operations.

Each capability is a deterministic engine with a verifiable spec — not a feature, but infrastructure.

01 / INGESTION

CAS Ingestion Engine

Parse any CAMS, KFintech, or broker CAS format — including locked, scanned, and consolidated statements.

throughput10,000 holdings/sec
02 / NORMALIZATION

Instrument Resolution

Canonical ID assignment via ISIN-first resolution. Aliases reconciled across AMC variants and naming conventions.

universe12,400+ instruments
03 / LOOK-THROUGH

Fund Decomposition

Recursive decomposition of mutual funds into underlying holdings, with effective exposure aggregation.

depth3 levels recursive
04 / RISK

Risk Decomposition Engine

Concentration (HHI), Neff, volatility, drawdown, fragility — fully decomposable to driver contribution.

reproducibility100% deterministic
05 / FACTORS

Factor Exposure Engine

Value, growth, momentum, quality, size, liquidity, volatility — portfolio DNA decomposed into factor intensities.

factors9 dimensions
06 / MACRO

Macro Sensitivity Engine

Portfolio sensitivity to RBI rates, inflation, oil, USD/INR, US recession, and liquidity tightening.

signals11 macro variables
07 / SCENARIO

Scenario Simulation

Deterministic propagation: macro shock → sector impact → weighted stock impact → portfolio drawdown.

scenariosavg run 1.8s
08 / EXPLAIN

Explainability Layer

Every metric traces to source file → transformation → calculation → methodology version. Audit-grade.

traceabilityend-to-end

Intelligence API

REST + streaming endpoints for ingestion, analysis, scenarios, factor exposure, and narrative generation.
